title: with AI I stopped writing code for my game and started making good game design decisions. a few of them just tonight.
author: ribatonline
selftext:
Four attempts at this game died because one person can't do it all. It's an MMORPG and they are famous for being impossible to finish solo. The fifth is being typed by 7-8 agents, and what that bought me isn't speed, it's that my whole day is design. Concrete: tonight the planner wrote 25 milestones and handed me 21 decisions that only I could make. That list is my job now. The bottleneck moved from annoying bug fixing to decision making.

One example, told properly: the taifa system. My game is loosely based on Al Andalus / Iberia of the 11th century, so I had time to read about it, and the history did the design work: striking coin in your own name was the declaration of independence, so in the game minting without a licence isn't refused, it's announced, and it hands the capital a reason for war. I would have never thought of that if my mind was boggled with in code, especially not coming from a game dev background, so I think that's really cool

The honest part : the agents needed a written contract to stop colliding, and my daily shorts got 8 Discord joins in 15 days, the game being designed well doesn't market itself. Soooo yeah.

Anyways for anyone curious, this is a browser MMO with full loot and guild wars, free, in pre-alpha currently. In this game I am hoping there will be 2 factions fighting against each other, 2 kings, and provinces for each faction. Provinces can rebel and ally with another against the king. Politics and Drama Inc.

Link is here, the game is live; the politics above are built and go live once tested. Playable and enjoyable, if I take my first testers' word for it.

[Ribat — a browser MMO](https://www.ribatonline.com/)
